_comment: enabled: turn the TDD RED-gate on when entering Phase 9 (or via /aidd-impl-start); off during setup/scaffolding/refactor. Session override: AIDD_TDD_OVERRIDE=1. testCommand: the runner the guard uses to decide RED/GREEN — the edited test file path is appended as the final argument. Change it for your stack (e.g. ["npx","jest"], ["pytest","-q"], ["go","test"]).
